wide = df.pivot(index='session_date', columns='asset_id', values='close').sort_index()
print('Last 3 rows of close prices:')
print(wide.tail(3).to_string())
rets = wide.pct_change().dropna()
recent = rets.tail(20)
mom = recent.sum()
vol = recent.std()
sharpe = mom / vol
print('\n20d momentum:')
print(mom.to_string())
print('\n20d vol:')
print(vol.to_string())
print('\n20d Sharpe:')
print(sharpe.to_string())
